identity.name: Evolution 9 Collection Hi-Beat
identity.one_liner: The debut reference for caliber 9SA5, a new Hi-Beat 36000 movement with an 80-hour reserve, in a dial textured after the white birch forests near the Shizukuishi studio.

provenance_events.description: The SLGH005 won the Men's Watch Prize at the 2021 Grand Prix d'Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG), one of watchmaking's most cited industry awards.

narrative.story: The SLGH005 introduced caliber 9SA5, Grand Seiko's newly designed Hi-Beat 36000 movement with a dual-impulse escapement, twin barrels, and an 80-hour power reserve — a substantial jump over the 55-hour reserve of the outgoing 9S85. Its silvery-white dial is textured to evoke the white birch forests surrounding the Grand Seiko Studio Shizukuishi. It also introduced the Evolution 9 case design, a reworking of Grand Seiko's angular, Zaratsu-polished case language for improved wearing comfort. The reference won the Men's Watch Prize at the 2021 Grand Prix d'Horlogerie de Genève.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial's birch-forest texture is stamped, so light plays differently across individual dials; the Evolution 9 case shape (shared with several later 9SA5 references) is distinct from the older 44GS and 62GS case lines and is worth confirming when comparing listings.
